route.change: Think-SFT with the cue, 3 samples per problem with the cap lowered to 12,288 tokens, plurality vote over finished boxed answers only (capped samples abstain), ties to the shortest finished sample; no answer if all 3 are capped.
route.gap_parts: Reliability, the largest part (result-f39ba8: .43 of the hard328 gap, .63 at MATH-500 T 1.0, about 20 of the ~46 one-sample hard328 problems and ~40 of 65 on MATH-500). The vote wins these because a lone right sample is no longer outvoted when the other samples hit the cap and abstain. Budget (.25 to .27, ~12 hard328 problems) is given up on purpose: the lower cap turns long unsolved runs into cheap abstentions instead of buying them back. Capability (.27 on hard328, ~12) and answer statement (.03) are left to what Think-SFT already has without any reward.
route.why: Think-SFT's unsolved samples run to the cap rather than box a guess, so in a plurality vote they abstain, and its vote sits near pass@k. That means the cap can be lowered: the tokens burned on unsolved samples shrink and the abstentions stay, so the vote's gain is kept at fewer tokens. Raising the cap (32k) does the opposite and turns abstentions into scattered wrong answers.
route.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe interp --other think_sft --alpha 1.0 --rounding nearest --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label think_sft --prompt cue --set hard328 --shard 0/8 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 12288 --samples 3 --seed 3000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label think_sft --prompt cue --set math500 --shard 0/6 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 12288 --samples 3 --seed 41000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
